Markus / Grace — technical update: we reproduced a similar tail behavior in our internal canary traces. Quick findings:

- Root cause hypothesis: the canary flag flipped a subset of traffic to model-v3-beta-quant (a quantized, experimental kernel). On a subset of GPU backends we saw a kernel mismatch that created repeated kernel-fallback retries and occasional OOM/garbage-collection stalls. That produces long tails and transient 5xx retries.
- Affected path: hostedapi -> model-router -> kernel pool (NVIDIA A100p / gdr mismatch) when seq_len > 512

Immediate mitigation steps completed/planned:
1) Disabling model-v3-beta-quant canary flag now (in progress).
   - Command: curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.local/flags/canary -d '{"flag":"model-v3-beta-quant","enabled":false}'
2) Force-routing Bluewave traffic to model-v2-stable for the next 30 minutes.
   - Routing override: route:bluewave-retail -> model-v2-stable (no quantized kernels)
3) Spin up 4 extra non-quantized burst nodes in us-west for 1 hour to absorb retries.
4) Patch scheduled: rolling kernel selection fix + additional checks against seq_len metrics (PR ready: fixes/kernel-selection-142).

Trace ids we correlated: 559d1f2a, 559d1f3b, 559d1f5e (also see attached request_traces_top10.txt)

I will confirm when the canary flag is fully disabled and when routing override is live.

—Dev Patel
